name: Hawaii Pop Con

blurb: Hawaii's pop-culture convention at the Blaisdell Exhibition Hall in Honolulu, with comics, trading and sports cards, and cosplay.

editions.evidence: Homepage hero text: 'JANUARY 9-10, 2027 ... A weekend of island vibes and collectibles at the Blaisdell Exhibition Hall, Honolulu'; meta description: 'Hawaii Pop Con returns in 2027 at the Neal S. Blaisdell Center, Honolulu.'

notes: The seed note said exact dates were not yet posted, but the live site now clearly shows January 9-10, 2027. The extractor's 'og' image resolved to the page's own URL rather than a real image file, so the cover instead uses the site's square sticker-style logo (hawaii-pop-con-logo-0tXK1bjy.jpg).
